title: Release Lane Ledger: Automated Handoff Scorecard & Security Gate for Cross-Team Roadmaps
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: cross-team releases often fail to ship cleanly because handoffs are informal (Slack threads, ad-hoc docs), security signoffs miss subtle infra constraints, and infra capacity/rollback plans are not visible at the roadmap level. Goal: build a lightweight, automated "Release Lane Ledger" that codifies per-release handoff state, computes a Handoff Scorecard, enforces a security gate for releases with sensitive surface area, and surfaces infra capacity signals to PMs and Eng leads. Scope: metadata model (owners, critical dependencies, gating teams), score computation (completeness, signoffs, infra capacity margin, test coverage), integrations (Console dashboard badge, Slack reminders, GitHub release links, Confluence handoff template), and optional auto-escalation rules for high-risk lanes. Out of scope: full workflow engine or replacing existing Linear lifecycle; we will integrate with Linear statuses and use Console as the UI surface. Constraints: minimal engineering lift for Q1 (prefer webhook-based integrations), must respect private repo/audit constraints for security team signoffs, and we cannot add additional infra scheduling telemetry beyond what infra already exports (use current capacity metrics endpoint).
acceptance_criteria: Ledger stored as a per-release artifact with owner, list of dependent teams, and critical paths
Automatic Handoff Score computed and visible in Console for each release (score breakdown: completeness, signoffs, infra_margin, tests)
Security gate toggles a BLOCKED status when security_review_required=true and security team has not signed off
Slack reminder automation posts to release channel at T-14d and T-3d with outstanding items
Console shows infra capacity margin pulled from infra capacity API and flags releases with <15% margin
Documentation: Confluence handoff template and runbook linked from Console
Rollback plan field captured and verified by Eng lead before changing status to In Review
